steps.instructions: Phase 1/2 SCOPE: map the controls in scope for the standard or policy the ask names: each control, the code, configuration or record that implements it, and the evidence it leaves. GROUND FIRST: query the code graph through the wicked-garden-search skill and the read-only estate shim, one call per lookup: "$WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/_estate_client.py --readonly call '{"tool":"SearchEntity","arguments":{"name":"<symbol>"}}' (always --readonly); then open and read every file you cite, at the lines you cite. READ-ONLY: create, edit or delete no file in any repository, commit nothing, and run no command that writes there; your output is the report.

Phase 2/2 COMPLIANCE REVIEW (compliance officer): report each control as met, partly met or not met, with its evidence at file:line or the record it rests on, and the gap and its remedy for each one not met, the most severe first. Change nothing yourself: a fix is a separate job. PASS only when every finding holds at file:line.
